# Tess Van Ghert

> We buy precious metal from companies. Compliant acquisition, global settlement, LBMA benchmark pricing, and full audit trail since 2011.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Introduction to Tess Van Ghert's precious metals trading services for corporates, treasury teams, insolvency practitioners, and industrial manufacturers.
- [Compliance](/compliance): KYC, KYB, sanctions and PEP screening, documented source of goods, chain of custody, and LBMA-accredited settlement framework.
- [AML Policy](/aml-policy): Anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist financing policy summary: risk-based approach, CDD, record keeping, and governance.
- [Insights](/insights): Practical notes from the desk on precious metals trading, compliance, and global settlement.
- [Corporate Liquidation Guide](/guides/corporate-liquidation): A B2B guide to selling precious metals at scale — valuation, documented source of goods, logistics, and settlement for treasury and insolvency teams.
